headlines.title: Trump orders signage warning visitors of ‘inaccurate information’ at Smithsonian
headlines.description: While he continues to seek control of the exhibits inside the Smithsonian Institution’s museums, President Donald Trump is trying a new tactic in the front yard.

headlines.title: With plans to renovate a D.C. golf course, Trump tees off another fight with residents
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — Unless a federal judge intervenes, President Donald Trump has said the administration will break ground on Sept. 1 for what the Department of the Interior is calling a new “world-class” golf course only a mile from the White House South Lawn.

headlines.title: Democrats poised to nominate Troy Jackson in must-win Maine Senate race
headlines.description: BANGOR, Maine — Former state Senate President Troy Jackson is on the cusp of becoming Democrats’ Senate nominee in Maine, starting a 101-day sprint to Election Day in a nationally watched, must-win race for his party.

headlines.title: Special Report: Trump delivers speech at rescheduled White House Correspondents’ Dinner
headlines.description: Watch President Donald Trump’s full speech at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner, which was rescheduled after a shooting at the previous dinner in April. Trump took swipes at some of the journalists in the room and some political rivals while touting his accomplishments.

headlines.title: Trump touts his accomplishments and relationship with the press at Correspondents' Dinner
headlines.description: President Trump gave lengthy speech at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner, where he insulted his political rivals and touted his accomplishments and relationship with the press.

headlines.title: Trump calls Obama's speech at past White House Correspondents' Dinner 'respectful'
headlines.description: President Trump recounts a previous White House Correspondents' Dinner during which former President Barack Obama gave a speech. Trump also reflects on his decision to run for office, and his relationship with the press.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump administration concedes that it canceled research grants in blue states
headlines.description: The Trump administration admitted that it terminated nearly 300 federal research grants “solely because” the projects were connected to states that voted against Trump in 2024

headlines.title: DNC committee sets up South Carolina to vote first in 2028 presidential primaries
headlines.description: South Carolina is poised to hold the first Democratic presidential nominating contest in 2028 after the Democratic National Committee’s powerful rules committee voted to keep the state at the front of the line.

headlines.title: Democrats reshape their primary calendar: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Ben Kamisar breaks down Democrats’ new presidential primary order. Plus, Kristen Welker explores the political pressure the ongoing Iran war is putting on Republicans.

headlines.title: Fresh wave of U.S. tariffs takes effect, hitting global trade partners
headlines.description: These new duties, which range from 10% to 12.5%, will take effect Friday morning, just as the previous tariffs expire.
